naturally in conversation while preserving the coherence of the user’s long-horizon interaction
history. MemConflict uses a two-stage process: synopsis generation followed by dialogue realization.

reader_claims.text: The benchmark uses LLM-generated session synopses and dialogues, with each assigned non-empty update, static fact, conditional binding, or distractor required to appear explicitly.

reader_claims.text: Answer Accuracy (AA) is the fraction of evaluated queries whose normalized system answer matches the gold answer.
Support Evidence Hit@K (SEH@K) is the fraction of queries for which the top-K retrieved items contain the gold supporting memory.

role_examples.review: This describes a timeline setting, not the operation of simulating a timeline.
